claims.statement: Tom Allen backed Antonio Pierre in a private catch-as-catch-can wrestling match against Greek George; the stakes are printed as 3200 a side.

claims.statement: Greek George beat Antonio Pierre, whom Tom Allen had backed, in two falls in the private wrestling match.
claims.excerpt: The private match between Antonio Pierre and Greek George, the wrestiers, took place

notes: Allen backed the wrestler; he did not wrestle. Stake printed as 3200 (probably $200, as the hint says). Excerpt joins a line break. Place not given.
